messages:
Priya Shah: Quick sync — need to lock scope for audit search SLA + retention buckets for enterprise launch. Customer asks: searchable audit for 1y, export in <30s for 50k events, and 7y cold storage.
Elliot Chen: +1. Do we have perf data on query times for big tenants? current ES cluster tops at ~20k/sec scan but search latency varies.
Priya Shah: We have bench data but not at 50k export size. Want launch criteria: (a) search SLA 95th < 15s for 50k, (b) export streaming with resume token, (c) retention tiers defined + legal hold.
Samir Patel: Legal hold is non-negotiable. Also need proof-of-delete workflows for retention expiry — audit trail for deletions.
Gloria Reyes: For SOC2 evidence, we must provide tamper-evident logs + HMAC-backed export manifest. Also need retention policy UI to show policy applied per tenant.
Marco Li: Ops question — cold storage location? S3 vs Glacier vs archive WORM? Cost delta big. If we do 7y on Glacier Deep, retrieval time is hours which breaks <30s export requirement for cold.
Priya Shah: Proposal: hot (90d) searchable, warm (1y) searchable but slower, cold (7y) archival with metadata index that allows export job to stream manifests + staged retrieval for full exports. Launch MVP: searchable up to 1y, archival 7y with async restore for full historical exports.
Elliot Chen: Implementation note: we can keep lightweight metadata index in Postgres for cold objects: event id, timestamp, object key. That lets us satisfy 'search returns IDs' quickly while full payload restores later. Example retention config: ```retention:
  hot: 90d
  warm: 365d
  cold: 7y
  legal_hold: true```
Samir Patel: That sounds acceptable. Need tamper-evidence: add signed manifests per export and store log of manifest in Vault (immutable append).
Gloria Reyes: Also add an export TTL window and export audit chain for customer evidence. For SOC2 acceptance we need docs + internal runbooks.
Priya Shah: OK can we map to launch gates? My draft: Gate 1 (MVP): search SLA for 90d & 1y ID-level search, export job with resume + signed manifest, retention policies CRUD in UI, legal hold flag. Gate 2: full payload fast-export for 50k events <30s (optimize later), WORM archival, SOC2 docs.
Marco Li: Timeline risk: Gate 2 requires infra (restore fast-path) + extra cost. Suggest we commit to Gate 1 for GA and backlog Gate 2 as enterprise opt-in.
Elliot Chen: Dev tasks: index metadata + export job, manifest signer, retention enforcement Cron, UI endpoints. Rough estimate: 3 sprints for Gate 1 with 2 engs + 1 ops.
Priya Shah: Dependencies: legal signoff (Gloria), security review (Samir), infra budget for archival (Marco). Who owns signoffs?
Gloria Reyes: I can take legal signoff but need acceptance criteria checklist from product.
Samir Patel: Security review after design doc. I'll block 2 days for threat model review.
Priya Shah: I'll produce a one-pager with acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow and tag reviewers.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly compliance deploy freeze on Fridays 18:00-22:00 UTC.
Priya Shah: Thanks — tagging action owners: @Gloria Reyes (legal), @Samir Patel (security), @Marco Li (ops), @Elliot Chen (eng). We'll reconvene next Wed to decide GV. :thumbsup:
